children.name: Panus similis
children.description: (FIGURES 10, 11) Pileus (4.9 B) 4 – 16 cm diameter, thin, deeply infundibuliform; surface brown to dark chestnut brown, finely velutinate at the centre, radially plicate-sulcate with the striae extending almost to the centre, margin curved downwards, ciliate. Lamellae decurrent, ochraceous buff, darkening at maturity, 1.5 – 3 mm broad, moderately spaced with lamellulae of five lengths; entire edge. Stipe central, 4 – 17 cm × 1.5 – 2 mm, solid, cylindric, slightly expanded at the base; surface concolorous with the pileus, uniformly velutinate and felt-like.
